title: Onboard view from STS-61 of the Hubble Space Telescope and moon together
description: STS061-57-021 (2-12 Dec 1993) --- This scene, captured with a 35mm camera from inside the Space Shuttle Endeavour, shows the Earth-orbiting Hubble Space Telescope (HST) and the Moon together.
caption: 哈勃空间望远镜
